entities.summary: Chrysanthus Notaras, also known as Chrysanthus of Jerusalem, was Patriarch of Jerusalem and a scholar in Eastern Orthodoxy. He was a mathematician, astronomer, geographer, and author. He is known for creating modern maps in the Greek language. He was one of Giovanni Domenico Cassini's students. He also built astronomical equipment.
